verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a GraphQL API with an interactive code explorer and a typed beta Node.js SDK. However, no evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec: there is no published GraphQL SDL or introspection schema file, and the OpenAPI probes at all candidate paths returned 404. The llms.txt file and the code explorer are documentation aids, not a downloadable API spec, so they count only as adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
